label.purpose: Field labels and control names. Sans-serif, tight tracking, no explicit line height.

heading.purpose: Level-1 panel and section titles. Sans-serif, uppercase, wide tracking.

value.purpose: Slider readouts, text input values, select values. Monospace, tabular-nums.

section.purpose: Level-3 sub-section headers. Monospace, uppercase, smallest size. Reads like a terminal label.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Default rest state for cards, toggles, and checkboxes.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 18%, transparent), 0 0 12px -2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint-color) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Standard elevated surface: buttons, badges, panels. Tight structural shadow + subtle tint halo.

shadows.name: sunken
shadows.value: inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 26%, transparent), inset 0 3px 8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint-color) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 30%, transparent))
shadows.purpose: Recessed wells for text inputs, selects, and textareas.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 22%, transparent), 0 0 20px -2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint-color) 32%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Interaction state: pointer is over the element.

shadows.name: active-glow
shadows.value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 20%, transparent), 0 0 28px -1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint-color) 48%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Interaction state: element is being pressed.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Toggle knob, slider thumb scale, micro-interactions.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Theme toggle icon crossfade, opacity transitions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Background-color, border-color, box-shadow, and transform on pressable elements.

motion.name: easing-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. Fast start, gentle deceleration.

motion.name: easing-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric easing for opacity and handle transitions.

motion.name: reduced-duration
motion.purpose: Reduced-motion duration in shared recipes; the slider thumb still uses 0ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default interactive button with solid tinted background and neon glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 44px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; background-color: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 38%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 18%, transparent), 0 0 12px -2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 18%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-image: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155) 8%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155) 8%, transparent)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 22%, transparent), 0 0 20px -2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 32%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); background-image: linear-gradient(color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155) 14%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155) 14%, transparent)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 20%, transparent), 0 0 28px -1px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 48%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact pill-shaped status indicator with solid tinted background.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; background-color: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 38%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 18%, transparent), 0 0 12px -2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Quiet tinted container that groups content. Soft background wash, subtle border, flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background-color: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 25%, oklch(0.277 0 0)) 60%, transparent); color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 38%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Recessed well for text entry with monospace value and sunken shadow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 25%, oklch(0.277 0 0)) 60%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 72%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 26%, transparent), inset 0 3px 8px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 30%, transparent)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Sliding switch with a knob that gains opacity and translates on check.
components.css: .ds-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-toggle-label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); } .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 34px; height: 20px; } .ds-toggle-input { appearance: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; background-color: oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 72%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toggle-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-knob { transform: translateX(16px); opacity: 1; } .ds-toggle-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Select
components.description: Native select with custom well styling and inline SVG chevron.
components.css: .ds-select-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-select { appearance: none; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 32px 8px 12px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); background-color: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 25%, oklch(0.277 0 0)) 60%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 72%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 26%, transparent), inset 0 3px 8px color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.411 0.012 51.866) 20%, color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.241 0.005 219.672) 30%, transparent)); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-select-chevron { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 12px; height: 12px; pointer-events: none; color: oklch(0.956 0.055 96.155); }

narrative.overview:
PG_LAB's visual system is a workshop lit by neon: a dark, dense ground where every surface earns its place through function, and color arrives as signal — a tinted glow on hover, a solid accent on a control's active state, a soft wash behind a grouped parameter panel. The interface is an instrument, not a decoration. It recedes when the experiment (canvas, shader, simulation) demands attention, and tightens when the operator needs precision.

The system is built on a tint architecture: one CSS variable (tintVars.color) sets the hue for an entire surface tree — background, border, shadow, and text derive from it through color-mix() in OKLCH. Its companion tintVars.onColor keeps text legible on a solid tint. Swapping both variables re-tints a component without touching its structure. Every surface is described by five independent axes — color, background, border, radius, elevation — exposed by surfaceStyles() in packages/ui.

Density is high by design. The control panel is a column of compact fields — sliders, selects, toggles, checkboxes — each with a 44px touch target but minimal visual footprint. The shell splits into a resizable panel and a stage, switching from row to column on (orientation: portrait); at 1024px and above its outer gap and padding grow from 8px to 16px.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with automatic light mode via light-dark() and color-scheme
OKLCH palette with three tonal registers per hue: bright (light mode), neutral, faded (dark mode)
Tint-driven surface system: one variable pair tints and labels an entire subtree
Five orthogonal surface axes: color, background, border, radius, elevation
Tactile interactions: scale(0.98) on press, neon glow on hover, focus ring on keyboard
System font stack — no custom fonts, no loading delay
Monospace for values, sans-serif for labels — two voices, one density

rules.name: The Tint Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Every colored surface sets tintVars.color and tintVars.onColor together. Nested surfaces that need a different hue reset both variables; they never inherit onColor from a parent with a different tint.

rules.name: The Three-Register Rule
rules.body: No hue exists as a single value. Each has bright, neutral, and faded variants. light-dark() picks the right register automatically; manual selection is a code smell.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif names things; monospace measures things. Mixing them on the same element is an error.

rules.name: The Glow-as-State Rule
rules.body: Glow is never decorative. It appears on hover, intensifies on press, and disappears at rest. A permanently glowing element is a bug.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows separate surfaces (stage from panel, well from panel). They don't float elements above the page — the flat-by-default ground makes raised surfaces meaningful.

dos: Do set tintVars.color and tintVars.onColor together on every tinted surface. Never set one without the other.

Do use color-mix(in oklab, ...) for all tint-derived backgrounds, borders, and shadows. The mix percentages are the system's vocabulary: 25% for soft backgrounds, 38% for subtle borders, 72% for strong borders, 18% for the resting halo, 32%/48% for hover/active glow.
Do use light-dark() for every color that adapts to theme. Never branch with a media query when light-dark() works.

Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on every transition. Use 1ms as the reduced duration in shared recipes (interactions.pressable, Toggle); the slider thumb currently uses 0ms and should be aligned on the next pass.
Do keep every interactive element at or above the 44×44px touch target, using an invisible ::before when the visual element is smaller.
Do compose surfaces from the five axes color, background, border, radius, elevation via surfaceStyles().
donts: Don't apply a permanent glow or shadow as decoration. Glow signals state; shadows signal elevation. A resting element should be flat or raised — never glowing.

Don't use hardcoded color values inside packages/ui components. All colors flow through tintVars.color, tintVars.onColor, surface.foreground, or surface.background. Direct palette references belong in token definitions (and in experiment-specific chart code, which is outside the shared primitives).
Don't mix sans-serif and monospace within a single text element. Labels are sans; values are mono. If a string serves both roles, split it into two elements.

Don't introduce new hues outside the eight named tints (neutral, aurora, solder, purple, amber, error, aqua, orange). The palette is closed by design; each hue exists in three registers and needs all three to work.
Don't add ad-hoc circular radii. Use radius.full (9999px), which produces a pill on rectangles and a circle on squares. The toggle knob's 50% is a holdout to migrate, not a precedent.
